[[File:ChonaBeneAzetal-TheTyrantsFist2.jpg|thumb|right|180px|[[Cho'na Bene]] jumping over Azetal gas.]]
'''Azetal''' was a specialized [[Gas/Legends|gas]] used in handheld torches and cutting equipment. It could be stored in small, refillable cylinders, which could then be attached to the nozzle of the torch.<ref name="abyss">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]''</ref>

Azetal gas can be found on [[Vaklin]].<ref name="TTF2">[[Purge – The Tyrant's Fist 2|''Purge – The Tyrant's Fist'' 2]]</ref>
